notes.title: Day One Patch 1.0.14
notes.content:
Hello players!

Launch day as been whirlwind for us dragons but we're so excited to see so many of you playing the The Sacred Acorn and enjoying it. Our work isn't done yet though. There's always bugs that players find on launch day, and we're really grateful to everyone that has reported issues and given feedback. Here's our first patch update details.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Overhaul of the Objectives in the Menu
[*] Fixed the pillar puzzle in Dusty Canyon
[*] Fixed the area titles displaying incorrectly when going to a new area
[*] Updated the Crystal Swamp main quest line
[*] Made a few areas a tiny bit more linear to help with finding yourself
[*] Fixed tribe torches showing progression in the Canyon arena
[*] Updated the Varghest boss (was too easy for many of you!)
[*] Fixed some typos and other inconsistencies
[*] Updated missing dialogue lines to some characters
[/list]
[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced essence drops for Tundra
[*] Rebalanced Kroan fights
[*] Rebalanced Varghest fight
[*] Rebalanced Glacicle fight
[/list]
[h3]Feedback and Bug Reports[/h3]
The best place to give us feedback and report bugs is on our Discord. We're active and involved in our community there so if you have Discord please consider joining! Bugs are more likely to be fixed when they are reported on the Discord.

[url=http://discord.afewdragons.com]http://discord.afewdragons.com[/url]

notes.title: The Sacred Acorn: HUGE demo update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello travellers!

We've just done a HUGE update to the demo, probably the biggest update we've done in the last year and a half! There are so many changes you almost might not recognise it, and we are so happy to be giving you all a proper taste of what the full game will be like when it releases in July.

Here's a brief overview of what has changed:

[list]
[*] All new tutorial!
[*] All new Timberglaive, the squirrel village!
[*] All new art for Ima and the squirrels in her tribe!
[*] Special demo access to late game ability Projection!
[*] A big overhaul of the Mushploom Caves!
[*] Sneak peeks at never before seen areas!
[*] Lots of new hidden secrets for you to discover 👀
[/list]

We hope you love the changes, and, as always, we welcome feedback. There may still be a bug or two, so please let us know if you find any and we'll fix ASAP. Happy adventuring!

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/FEsvSz2Gq8][b]Discord[/b][/url] to ask questions, give feedback, and join the discussions!

notes.title: Meet Gotlas, Your Loyal Map Companion
notes.content:
In the enchanting world of Tansira, where danger and adventure lurk around every corner, you play as brave little squirrel Ima, embarking on a perilous journey to save your tribe. 

The Sacred Acorn is not just your typical action-adventure game; it's a heartwarming tale of courage and determination, and to help you on your quest are a myriad of cute companions, each with their own unique abilities. The newest critter to travel by your side is an unlikely but indispensable companion - Gotlas, the map-bearing creature that adds a unique twist to gameplay and navigation.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6428025d46d13434a1b6ac66/f9611f55-dc14-4cb9-8aea-c1e611a1bd35/TSA+Maps.gif[/img]

[h2]Unlocking the World: Map Stones and Map Pieces[/h2]
Tansira is a vast and diverse world, filled with mysterious forests, ancient ruins, daunting mountains, and much more. Navigating through such a complex environment would be a challenge without something to guide you or refer to, but we also didn’t want there to be an always visible map. We call our game deceptively cute after all, and for us that means we don’t want anything to be [i]too[/i] easy.

The heart of the navigation system lies in the Map Stones. As players discover and activate these stones through exploration, they unlock new map pieces for each area they explore. This gradual discovery mirrors Ima's journey of uncovering the secrets of her world one step at a time. With Map Stones scattered across Tansira, players are encouraged to explore every nook and cranny to unlock them.

The challenge is that Ima is only able to view the map for the area she is in by looking at the map stones themselves, and she will only be able to view the piece of the map that she has unlocked. For those players that want to be able to bring up the map to check at any time, we have something else.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6428025d46d13434a1b6ac66/c43e1b19-2a84-431c-b856-55cbe3d807ba/TSA+Gotlas.gif[/img]

[h2]A New Companion: Gotlas, The Walking Map[/h2]
The newest companion to be added to the game is Gotlas, a magic infused golem-like walking map creature with map on his back; a living cartographic tool that follows the player around and shows them any unlocked map pieces for the area they are currently in.

To have access to the map any time they want, players need to actively choose Gotlas as their current companion. This adds an interesting layer of decision-making to the gameplay - do you stick with a combat-focused companion or opt for Gotlas to ensure you're heading in the right direction? 

Balancing companionship and utility becomes essential for a successful journey through Tansira. Players won’t be locked into traveling with Gotlas though - they can return home and switch him out with any other companion they have already unlocked at any time, allowing them to be strategic when it comes to exploration, tackling challenging areas, and defeating bosses.

Can’t wait to give our squirrely action adventure game a whirl? We have a free playable demo for The Sacred Acorn available now.

Or, if you want to join the conversation, you can join us on [url=https://discord.afewdragons.com/]Discord[/url]. We look forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Development Update - The Canyon Region is finished!
notes.content:
Exciting news on the Sacred Acorn front! The development of The Canyon region is now complete, and it's packed with stunning visuals, hidden secrets, and exciting combat that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1259760/ss_5bc1bde5cfc307086926973e0eb00ab38b558a6d.1920x1080.jpg[/img]

We've also added new enemies and NPCs with unique abilities to make the Canyon experience unique and challenging. And for those who love cute creatures, you’re going to love the final reveal of the little birds (concept art only for now, sorry!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39002958/c8f436fdae9d8478409ea3fcc59eda70fcd01d98.gif[/img]

We’re about to commence development for the next region, and that’s going to have a very different feel to the three we already have. Stay tuned for more updates on the game's development, and if you haven’t already, join our [url=http://discord.afewdragons.com/]Discord[/url] for more regular updates.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1259760/ss_da19e3f5b0d9507a73b4f9fcb16173412629db1c.1920x1080.jpg[/img]
